title: Optimize images
description: Makes AVIF and WebP files at several widths from a page's original photos, and writes a TypeScript list of what it made.

input.description: Folder of original photos (PNG, JPEG or WebP), relative to the workspace root. Missing means no photos yet.

output.description: Folder the sized files are written to, emptied first. Usually the app's public/images.

manifest.description: TypeScript file listing each photo's size and the widths made.

widths.description: Widths to make, in pixels. Widths larger than the original are skipped.

formats.description: Formats to make. WebP alone suits NgOptimizedImage, whose preload of a priority image uses the img's format.
